answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 39834 Country: India Title: Allah (swt) blessed me a baby boy on 06.05.2012 at 6.00 am. Please suggest minimum five meaningful names Question: Allah (swt) blessed me a baby boy on 06.05.2012 at 6.00 am. Please suggest minimum five meaningful names? Also suggest how is the name Mohammed Izhan for him? Answer ID: 39834 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1425/1129/B=1433) Muhammad Azhan: It is the plural of Zihan i.e. brilliant, you may keep this name. Given are some names, you can choose any of them: Arman, Salman, Farhan, Affan, Noman. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
